raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to identify the correct photo and headstone of the oldest flavor in the Ben & Jerry's Flavor Graveyard as of the end of 2022. This error set the process off course from the very beginning, as subsequent steps relied on the initial identification of the oldest flavor's headstone. Instead of directly locating the oldest flavor headstone and inspecting its associated photo, WebSurfer engaged in inefficient scrolling and searches, leading to a prolonged and ultimately incorrect resolution of the problem.
